scientific_integrity.homotopy_claim: No wedge splitting or full homotopy equivalence is asserted.
scientific_integrity.independent_computational_crosscheck: A separate mod-two checker rebuilds the Alexander dual by an independence-number recurrence and computes original simplicial boundary ranks; this is a computational cross-check, not independent mathematical auditing.
scientific_integrity.numerical_precision: All coefficients are exact integers; no floating-point inference is used.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Self-contained standard-library exact integer Morse verifier and captured output are included. All vertex subsets, directed cover incidences, and signed reduced boundaries are checked.

scientific_limitations: Only the exact integral homology and connectivity of two specified sixteen-vertex complexes are established. The higher attaching homotopy classes, full homotopy types, and any extension to a graph family remain undetermined. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be excluded.
title: Two-torsion in the Clebsch total four-cut complex and its Alexander dual
